labels.note: The Premises is the whole Land and Building (Section 2(a)), so the Building's Presumed Square Footage is the premises area; subject to post-completion remeasurement (Section 2(b)). Lease Year 1 Annual Base Rent $1,981,760.00 = $5.50 x 360,320. Lease Commencement Date is Substantial Completion (estimated January 1, 2023), so commencement, rent commencement, expiration and dated rent steps are not labeled; rent table is by Lease Year ($5.50 rising 2% a year to $6.98 in Lease Year 13). Section 4(a)(ii) abates Base Rent for an 'Abatement Period' that the lease never defines (Base Rent Commencement Date is three months after the Lease Commencement Date but not before April 1, 2023), so free_rent is not labeled.
